data.name: Humam
data.long_meaning: Companion; One who is with others; A person who shares the company of others. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'hammama', which means 'to be with' or 'to accompany'.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, a companion is someone who stands by one's side through thick and thin, offering emotional support and companionship.

in_urdu.name: همام

The Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) once said, "A person is not a true believer if he does not desire for his brother that which he desires for himself." This strengthens the importance of the bond between individuals and underscores the significance of companionship.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Humam evokes the idea of being a companion in the spiritual journey towards God. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) emphasized the importance of the collective journey towards God, saying, "None of you will enter paradise until he loves me, and he will not love me unless he follows me." Therefore, Humam, as a name, can be seen as a reminder to be a companion to others on the spiritual path and maintain close ties with them to grow closer to God.
